# RopeConstraint

- Inherits [`Constraint`](constraint.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("RopeConstraint")`

A joint that keeps two attachments no farther apart than `Length`, such as a rope, a chain or a leash. While it is slack, it does nothing. With the winch enabled, `Length` moves toward `WinchTarget` at `WinchSpeed`, and stalls if that needs more force than `WinchForce`.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Color` | `Color3` | `Color3.new(0.6, 0.6, 0.6)` | read/write | The color of the line the rope is drawn as. |
| `Length` | `number` | `5` | read/write | The largest distance between the two ends, in meters. The winch changes it. |
| `Thickness` | `number` | `0.1` | read/write | The thickness of the line the rope is drawn as, in meters. |
| `WinchEnabled` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | Whether the winch is moving `Length` toward `WinchTarget`. |
| `WinchForce` | `number` | `10000` | read/write | The largest tension the winch can pull against, in newtons. A heavier load is not moved. |
| `WinchSpeed` | `number` | `1` | read/write | The speed at which the winch takes rope in or lets it out, in meters per second. |
| `WinchTarget` | `number` | `5` | read/write | The length the winch moves toward, in meters. |
